//: No secrets and no connection strings here or in user-secrets. Local dev reads the same kv-poshared secrets as Azure via DefaultAzureCredential (`az login`). Without a Gemini key the deterministic fakes take over and the client shows the FAKE AI banner.
//Ollama: With no Gemini key the fakes take over, and four canned lines is a poor way to look at the app. Set Enabled true with `ollama serve` running and the dialogue is written by a local model instead — free, offline, and never allowed in Production. `ollama pull qwen3:8b` first.

Serilog.//Seq: Structured log viewer from docker-compose (SCRIPTS/azurite.ps1 starts it). The sink buffers quietly if it is not running.

Auth.//AllowDevEntra: Set true to wire the dev Entra OIDC scheme. PoFightJudge:AzureAd:DevClientId / DevTenantId come from kv-poshared (PoFightJudge--AzureAd--ClientId-Dev / --TenantId-Dev). When the KV secret is missing the API silently keeps guest-only — fail-closed.

PoFightJudge.//Azurite: Endpoints only, still no connection string: Azurite runs with --oauth basic over HTTPS (dev cert). Applied over the Key Vault values in Program.cs when FeatureManagement:UseAzurite is on.
